page.layout: One page of text in a single main column, with cut-off marginal notes at the right edge of the column (partly hidden by the binding and the neighbouring page); page number and running head at the top; a fragment of the facing page visible at the far right edge.

main_text.l: rem novis ritibus offerri & proponi, non
idem sub novis ritibus proponitur: nec propterea
novi-tus ad eandem rem significatam expr-
imitur: sed ex perpetuo usu & consuetudine
Ecclesiæ de iis verbis erit statuendum & ju-
dicandum. Et hinc fit, ut tametsi nunquam
extet in veteri testamento expressa saepius-
Christus, sed expressis verbis eam primus posuit
Apostolus: Veteres tamen ex usu scripturæ
& facile intelligebant eam, non addita aliqua
pascha. Hebr. 11. v. 28. Et applicatio novi
ritus, cujus ad eandem rem signatam non
in Ecclesia, ut ad verborum proprietatem
eadem, tametsi ritus diversi, quibus res eadem applicata

page.notes: Marginal notes at the right edge are cut off and largely illegible; only fragments are visible (e.g. "plic", "Fau", "mo", "no", "tat", "ru", "ve", "ce", "da", "ea", "pe", "P", "q", "C") and they are not transcribed. Several words in the text are overprinted by show-through and damaged; readings in the right-hand portion, such as "novi-tus", "saepius-sis", "Corinthii", "Christus" and the Hebrews reference, are doubtful and may carry [?] in a fuller transcription.
